posts.name: ketigid
posts.cooked:
[quote=““Blighted Streets””]
Increase damage dealt to hero targets by 1.
At the end of each hero’s turn, if that hero dealt no damage this turn, their player may discard 2 cards to destroy this card.
When this card is destroyed, play the top card of the villain deck.
[/quote]

[quote=““Null-Point Calibration Unit””]
When Absolute Zero would take cold damage, regain that many HP instead.
[/quote]

""Thermodynamics"":

Power: Absolute Zero deals himself 1 fire damage or 1 cold damage.

When Blighted Streets and Null-Point Calibration Unit in play, can Absolute Zero use Thermodynamics to deal himself 1 cold damage, then increase that damage to 2 because of Blighted Streets, then regains 2 HP because of Null-Point Calibration Unit, then go on to discard 2 cards to destroy Blight Streets because he did “no damage” this turn?
posts.raw:

[/quote]


[quote=""Null-Point Calibration Unit""]
When [i]Absolute Zero[/i] would take cold damage, regain that many HP instead.
[/quote]


[quote=""Thermodynamics""]
[b]Power:[/b] [i]Absolute Zero[/i] deals himself 1 fire damage or 1 cold damage.
[/quote]


When Blighted Streets and Null-Point Calibration Unit in play, can Absolute Zero use Thermodynamics to deal himself 1 cold damage, then increase that damage to 2 because of Blighted Streets, then regains 2 HP because of Null-Point Calibration Unit, then go on to discard 2 cards to destroy Blight Streets because he did "no damage" this turn?

posts.name: Rabit
posts.cooked: Yep, because Null-Point says “instead” - he didn’t deal damage, he only regained HP.
posts.raw: Yep, because Null-Point says "instead" - he didn't deal damage, he only regained HP.

posts.name: dragonlordged
posts.cooked: My reading would be that he dealt damage, but he did not take damage. The NPCU only replaces “takes damage” with “takes no damage” and the taking damage trigger requires something to be dealing damage.
posts.raw: My reading would be that he dealt damage, but he did not take damage.  The NPCU only replaces "takes damage" with "takes no damage"  and the taking damage trigger requires something to be dealing damage.

posts.name: Tegulus
posts.cooked: I think “would” and “instead” are the key words here. They imply that AZ “would” (but doesn’t) take damage. “Instead” (in place of that) he regains hit points. So he is never dealt damage.
posts.raw: I think "would" and "instead" are the key words here. They imply that AZ "would" (but doesn't) take damage. "Instead" (in place of that) he regains hit points. So he is never dealt damage.

posts.name: TheJayMann
posts.cooked: And, if he never was dealt damage, he never dealt damage either.
posts.raw: And, if he never was dealt damage, he never dealt damage either.
